data.narrative:
Arxlight is a seed-stage company in the Defense & Security sector competing in a universe of 10 comparable companies: 2 public and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic. The peer set spans a wide valuation range reflecting stage and capability differences.

A peer-median methodology anchors the analysis. The five closest comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Castelion ($1.0B Series A), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—yield a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range from $125M to $4.0B. This peer-median result is the only quantitative method applicable given available data constraints.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.1B, centered on $1.0B. The wide spread in the comparable universe ($125M–$4.0B) introduces material uncertainty around the point estimate. Key variables not quantified here—Arxlight's revenue trajectory, customer concentration, technology differentiation within the Defense & Security stack, and actual funding history—significantly affect where the company lands within or outside this range. The seed stage and limited methodological diversity (peer-median only) suggest this estimate carries moderate confidence and should be refined with additional financial and operational data as the company progresses.
